name: AI/BI: Marketing Campaign effectiveness
narrative:
You run growth for a brand advertising across TikTok, Instagram, Google Ads and Email in 20 markets. Late in 2025 revenue and conversions fall off a cliff — but spend never dropped, so return on ad spend craters and nobody can say why. On the dashboard the map lights up: Germany and France go red while everywhere else stays green.

Ask Genie and it names the culprit — a new localized TikTok creative, "Fall Sale - v2 (DE/FR)", swapped in on September 1 inside the Q4 Growth Push campaign, converting at ~0.35% against the usual ~3%. It even quantifies the damage: about $62k of spend wasted and ~$440k of revenue lost. Synthetic data, a governed metric view, an AI/BI dashboard and Genie — a fix a marketer can act on the same day.
